verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS platform that holds customer data, so controlling how long that data is kept and deleting it is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents retention settings, deletion controls, or data-purge options. Nearby items do not count toward this story: MCP permission scoping ("within limits you set"), GDPR framework support, and HIPAA disclosure-log templates describe other capabilities, not control over the product's own data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
